scope: One operating-system user on this machine. Discovery is not guaranteed activation and does not install a cloud-account plugin.

hosts.name: Codex CLI / IDE / desktop skills
hosts.limit: User-scoped for local projects. Restart or refresh discovery when needed; cloud environments need their own installation.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.invoke: /mechanism-figures or ask to use the skill
hosts.limit: Local personal skills apply across projects; writing this folder does not upload the skill to Claude web/Cowork account storage.

hosts.name: Cursor
hosts.invoke: Ask Cursor to use mechanism-figures; select the skill in the supported host UI
hosts.limit: Shared local skill discovery. Cursor cloud sync is a separate user-controlled feature; native ~/.cursor/skills sync is not enabled by this installer.

hosts.name: Gemini CLI
hosts.invoke: Ask to use mechanism-figures; review the host's skill activation consent
hosts.limit: User-level agent-skills directory; workspace policy or activation consent can still apply.

hosts.name: OpenCode
hosts.invoke: Ask OpenCode to load mechanism-figures through its skill tool
hosts.limit: Global agent-compatible discovery. Existing skill permissions and host settings remain unchanged.

hosts.name: GitHub Copilot local skill clients
hosts.invoke: Ask Copilot to use mechanism-figures in a supported local agent client
hosts.limit: Local personal skills are not automatically copied to GitHub-hosted coding-agent environments.

hosts.name: Windsurf / Devin Desktop
hosts.limit: Adapter covers the documented legacy Windsurf global path. Current Devin Desktop can also discover the shared ~/.agents/skills path; no cloud setting is changed.

hosts.name: OpenClaw
hosts.invoke: Ask the local OpenClaw agent to use mechanism-figures
hosts.limit: Shared personal skill discovery applies to the default OpenClaw state. A custom OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR uses separate configured roots and is not automatically covered. Agent eligibility and permissions still apply.

account_surfaces.name: ChatGPT web / mobile and account-wide plugin use
account_surfaces.route: portable plugin package; install through a supported account/workspace plugin flow
account_surfaces.limit: A GitHub repository, local skill folder or local marketplace entry is not a universal public-directory listing or account-wide installation.

account_surfaces.name: Claude account skills
account_surfaces.route: Upload the standalone skill ZIP through the account's supported skill management UI
account_surfaces.limit: Local Claude Code skill files do not automatically upload to account skill storage. Preserve the synced directory and provider settings.
